summary: Insteel Industries filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share, payable June 26, 2026 to holders of record June 12, 2026. This is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a capital return program, going-private, or strategic review. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or tender offer elements. No special-situation mechanics, advisors, or regulatory clocks are involved. The only action is a standard board declaration of a regular dividend, which falls outside the defined special-situations categories.
